name: lab-notes
description: An AI lab notebook for experimental physics. Dictate or type what you did, drop in notebook photos and instrument files, and get entries where every number cites the file it came from, with failed runs and missing details flagged. Talk through a procedure and get a manual for the next student. Teach it how your lab loads and plots data, then plot runs the lab's way. Reads instrument data (QCoDeS) read-only; originals are never changed. AI-drafted; nothing is shared beyond the model calls Claude Code already makes.
